name: Romp of Dump
source:
『Welcome to the Dumpir Prison, a prison full of lunatics.

1992, Dumpir, a city of pleasure and immorality.

When this place, threatened by the shadow of a serial killer, was still called paradise....

The Dumpir Prison, called the "Dump," is a cesspool where those who misbehave in the city at night are thrown in.

There was a bored death row prisoner there…

[From [url=https://zakurosuke.itch.io/romp-of-dump]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“欢迎来到杜姆皮尔监狱，一座关押着疯子的监狱。

1992年，杜姆皮尔，一座充满享乐和不道德的城市。

当这个受到连环杀手阴影威胁的地方还被称为天堂的时候……

杜姆皮尔监狱（Dumpir Prison）被称为“垃圾场”，是一个污水坑，那些夜间在城市里行为不端的人被扔进里面。

那里有一个无聊的死囚……”

[来自[url=https://zakurosuke.itch.io/romp-of-dump]itch.io[/url]]
